stories.story_fr: Les ventes ont atteint 4,84 milliards de dollars, en hausse de 6 % en dollars US.
stories.story_en: Sales were $4.84 billion, up 6 percent in US dollars.
stories.quote: Sales were $4.84 billion, up 6 percent in US dollars

stories.story_fr: Le résultat d'exploitation GAAP a augmenté de 18 % pour atteindre 775 millions de dollars.
stories.story_en: GAAP operating income was $775 million, up 18 percent.
stories.quote: GAAP operating income was $775 million, up 18 percent compared to the prior year.

stories.story_fr: Le résultat d'exploitation Non-GAAP a augmenté de 18 % pour atteindre 911 millions de dollars.
stories.story_en: Non-GAAP operating income was $911 million, up 18 percent.
stories.quote: Non-GAAP operating income was $911 million, up 18 percent compared to the prior year.

stories.story_fr: Le flux de trésorerie d'exploitation s'est élevé à 1,04 milliard de dollars.
stories.story_en: Cash flow from operations was $1.04 billion.
stories.quote: Cash flow from operations was $1.04 billion.

stories.story_fr: La société a retourné 768 millions de dollars aux actionnaires via dividendes et rachats.
stories.story_en: The company returned $768 million of cash to shareholders through dividends and share repurchases.
stories.quote: The Company returned $768 million of cash to shareholders through its annual dividend payment and share repurchases.
